issues.description: The UML in the problem statement and the task description indicate getTotalNumberOfStudents() should be a public method, but the solution implementation declares it as protected. This visibility mismatch contradicts the specification and may confuse students about the intended API (and could cause test access issues if tests expect a public method).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getTotalNumberOfStudents() method public to match the UML and problem description (declare as public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()). Update the solution (and, if desired, the template comments/signature hints) so the visibility matches the specification.
